subject: Quick ask: Two-line outcome & 15m for a short testimonial?
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@shoplane.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@shoplane.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: Two-line outcome & 15m for a short testimonial?

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Huge thanks again for running the week-long integration with Redwood Dedicated. We saw the production replica execute your fulfillment inference path end-to-end and wanted to recap the highlights before we close out the engagement. Short summary attached (sheet + one image).

Key outcomes we measured on the pilot workload (50k daily requests simulated):
- 42% reduction in average inference cost per 1k tokens (quantization + caching)
- P95 latency improved from 430ms -> 210ms under steady-state burst
- Cache hit rate stabilized at ~28% for your most common prefixes

Would you be comfortable sharing a two-line quote (one sentence) we could use in a short case blurb, and/or hopping on a 15-minute call next week to record a 30–45s testimonial clip? We can provide a one-line draft for you to tweak — happy to make it trivial.

Attachments: shoplane_poc_metrics_Q2_2027.xlsx (spreadsheet), realtime_latency_graph.png (PNG)

If easier, reply with a thumbs-up and we’ll follow up with a draft.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0130
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@shoplane.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@shoplane.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: Two-line outcome & 15m for a short testimonial?

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the recap and the files, they look great and line up with what our ops team is seeing. The latency improvement in particular was noticeable during our afternoon peak testing.

Happy to provide a short quote. Draft below — feel free to edit: 
"With Redwood, we reduced inference latency by ~50% while cutting predicted token spend; the integration was smooth and the Dedicated instance performed reliably under load."

I can do a quick 15-minute call on Wednesday (Jul 7) at 11:00am PT if that works for you — Tom will join if available. Otherwise we can just use the sentence above.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Director of Engineering, ShopLane Inc.
alyssa@shoplane.com

Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: Two-line outcome & 15m for a short testimonial?

Ha — nice. Landing a concise customer line is ideal here. If Alyssa signs off on that draft, we should: 
1) Turn it into a 1-sentence, 30-word max approved quote for marketing.
2) Add a one-sentence attribution (title + company).
3) Offer a two-sentence alt for case study use.

Dev: can you prep a super-short edit set (quote, alt, and a 2-sentence case blurb) and drop into the HubSpot deal record? Lauren: please add the recording option to the outreach so we can capture a brief clip if Alyssa confirms the call.

I'll wait to push the assets live until we have Alyssa's explicit approval.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra

rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick ask: Two-line outcome & 15m for a short testimonial?

Perfect — thanks Alyssa, that draft reads great and keeps it concrete. Wednesday 11:00am PT works for me; I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (3 bullets: 1) confirm quote wording, 2) capture 30–45s clip, 3) quick follow-ups on next steps).

Rishi / Dev / Lauren — I’ve dropped the HubSpot deal link here for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2071 and attached the final metrics spreadsheet to the invite. If you want to pre-populate the suggested marketing line it can be: 
"ShopLane reduced inference latency by ~50% and cut per-token cost by over 40% after switching to Redwood Dedicated; integration was straightforward and reliable."

Alyssa — we’ll treat anything you record as reviewable before publishing and will only use the exact quote you approve. See you Wednesday.

— Hannah
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
